title: Ep 20 — OpenAI builds ChatGPT its own IT department, and the relationship quiz that hit eleven thousand dollars in a month
description: OpenAI ships a conversational Admin plugin that already resolves forty five per cent of its own internal IT tickets and publishes first benchmarks for its own inference chip, while Claude Code lands a useful batch of permission and reliability upgrades and Anthropic, Cursor, Replit, Lovable and Bolt stay quiet for a third stretch running. Plus a deep dive on a viral relationship-compatibility quiz that reportedly took two well known bootstrappers to eleven thousand dollars in its first month, niched for Steve's audience as a shareable prize-draw entry mechanic for PlayFundWin, and why Thursday's Department for Transport charging-point statistics matter for EV-Partnerships.
